Use case: ui-mockup. High-fidelity portrait MOBILE WEB APP screen for VibeScroll, refined design 2 "Vertical knowledge atlas", no phone hardware. Very polished cool white #F7F9FC, navy readable sans type, restrained teal selected branches, soft muted root accents, calm precise spacing, almost no descriptive prose, no gradients.
Top compact header small yellow scroll mark and VibeScroll, search. Heading "Library". Show two clear large roots "Personal" and "Business" side by side at the top, Business selected. NO duplicate Business card below roots.
A genuinely downward, readable branching tree. Beneath Business: Product expanded and Marketing collapsed. Beneath Product: Customer experience expanded and Pricing collapsed. Under Customer experience a selected white INSIGHT card: title "Show one clear next step", small notebook thumbnail, badge "Insight", one "View source" link. From it one elegant downward arrow labeled "Used in proposal" to a small teal outline card "Simplify onboarding", subtitle "Demo shop · Proposal", button "Review". Everything auto-aligned, sparse partial tree, no dense graph hairball, no tiny labels. Parent cards expand with a chevron. Very little text.
Bottom fixed bar with EXACTLY FIVE evenly spaced large touch actions IN THIS EXACT ORDER: Home, Library active, Save, Projects, Account. Save is a centered circular yellow plus button with visible label Save; two actions on each side. Account has person-circle icon, no unlabeled avatar as replacement. Never add a sixth destination. Bottom safe area. Small footer above bar "Concept · sample content". This is variant A, overview-first atlas, clear relationships and comfortably spaced usable mobile UI. Fit the screen, no horizontal overflow or giant wasteful header. No fictional stats, prices or completed-work claims.

Use case: ui-mockup. High-fidelity portrait MOBILE WEB APP UI for VibeScroll, variation B of the approved cool-white vertical atlas design: "Focused branch". No phone hardware, no hands. Cool off-white canvas #F7F9FC, navy readable clean sans, teal selection, subtle rounded rectangles, precise spacing, yellow small scroll identity. No gradients or decorative landscapes.
Top compact VibeScroll brand, search icon. Title "Library". Root controls Personal / Business, Business selected. Compact breadcrumb "Business / Product". Beneath: a VERTICAL left-to-right lightly indented branching spine with full-width category rows rather than a wide miniature canvas. Active row "Customer experience" with open chevron; sibling "Pricing" collapsed. From active row curve a thin line DOWN to TWO insight cards stacked vertically: "Show one clear next step" active with small source thumbnail and "View source"; "Explain the benefit first" compact unselected. At the bottom selected insight's real project connection is a compact "Used in proposal" arrow to "Simplify onboarding", "Demo shop", button "Review proposal".
Make nested relationships evident through the continuous vertical spine and depth indentation. Do not merely show flat list of text. A small visible "Overview" button in header of branch lets users return to the broad tree. No duplicate Business root. Native scroll, large enough readable labels and actions, little text.
Bottom fixed navigation EXACTLY FIVE actions ordered Home, Library active, centered circular yellow plus Save, Projects, Account. Two buttons either side of Save. Safe area. Tiny "Concept · sample content". Faithful calm evolution of atlas aesthetic, a focused phone version for deep categories. No fictitious prices, statistics, completed-work claims, or excessive prose.

Use case: ui-mockup. Beautiful realistic WIDE DESKTOP web app dashboard design for VibeScroll, consistent with approved bright Vertical knowledge atlas: cool white canvas, navy slim sidebar, readable modern sans serif, teal active accents, restrained yellow Save action. No gradient, glass, marketing hero, giant greeting or fake money. Every value is illustrative within explicitly labeled "Example workspace".
Left slim navy rail: VibeScroll small yellow scroll mark, Home selected, Library, Projects, Account. Top search and yellow "+ Save". Main title "Home", small label "Example workspace".
Three compact statistical tiles in one row: "Saved posts 12", "Ready insights 28", "Proposals to review 3", with visible small scope "Example data". Then an elegant two-column dashboard:
LEFT main panel "Your knowledge": a genuinely VERTICAL tidy miniature hierarchy with two root cards Personal and Business, branches beneath Personal to Health and Cooking, beneath Business to Product and Marketing. Business/Product expanded into "Customer experience", one selected insight "Show one clear next step". Use clean curved membership connectors, short labels, no dense circles or forced graph zoom.
RIGHT panel "Next step": proposal "Simplify onboarding", project "Demo shop", button "Review proposal", source link "View insight". Under this an honest horizontal three-stage chart "Saved → Ready → Used in proposals" with stage numbers 12 / 10 / 3, label "Sample post counts" (not same as 28 insight count). Compact under that "Project progress" with distinct statuses To review, Planned, Change ready, no claims of benefit or auto approval.
Below main panels small "Recently saved" strip with three thumbnail cards and short titles. Clear dashboard hierarchy, attractive content-rich useful visuals, no paragraphs. Footer "Design concept · all content is illustrative". Align units so posts and insights are not confused. Strong user-facing product UI, not a spreadsheet, no meaningless success percentage.

Use case: ui-mockup. High-fidelity portrait MOBILE WEB APP project proposal detail for VibeScroll, design 3 "Proposal trail" adapted to approved design 2 cool white surfaces and navy/teal accents, yellow centered Save. No phone hardware. Readable short labels, generous spacing, crisp thin connectors, minimum descriptive prose, no gradients.
Compact header small yellow scroll mark VibeScroll, search icon. Back breadcrumb "Projects / Demo shop". Title "Simplify onboarding", badge "Proposal · To review".
Stack a genuinely VERTICAL trail of connected cards:
First compact card "Saved post", thumbnail of plain notebook, short label "Make the next step obvious", link "View source".
Downward thin arrow.
Second card "Insight", claim "Show one clear next step".
Downward thin arrow.
Third selected teal-outlined card "Proposal", "Simplify onboarding", link "Why this fits", status "To review".
Then lower outlined muted card "Plan", status "Not prepared". Outline dotted connector leading to muted future card "Change", status "Not started". NO checkmarks on unstarted stages.
Near Plan, a clear single primary button "Review preparation". A small readable hint "Review sources, project and cost first". This opens preparation review, not paid processing or coding. No invented money or credits, no confirmed outcome claims.
Bottom FIXED bar EXACTLY FIVE touch actions ordered Home, Library, centered circular yellow plus Save, Projects selected, Account. Two items either side of Save. Large touch targets, safe-area space. Small "Concept · sample content". Keep bottom bar distinct from step cards and visible. A calm beautiful coherent usable project journal, novice-friendly, no GitHub jargon or code console.
